members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both fix malformed OAuth discovery well-known paths caused by trailing slash handling in buildWellKnownPath()/buildDiscoveryUrls(). #2214 changes the single-trailing-slash strip (`if (pathname.endsWith('/')) pathname.slice(0,-1)`) to a regex that strips all trailing slashes (`pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')`) in both buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls. #2215 makes the identical change to buildWellKnownPath but extracts it into a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper, and additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback() to check pathname === '' instead of pathname === '/' so the root-path short-circuit stays consistent with the new normalization. #2214 does not touch shouldAttemptFallback, leaving that check out of sync with the normalized empty-string root path its own regex change produces.
